prompt: Explain the difference between renewable and non-renewable energy sources, giving two practical examples for each.
system_prompt: You are a helpful and knowledgeable science assistant. Provide clear definitions and accurate examples.
expected_aspects: Definition of renewable energy (replenished naturally on a human timescale / infinite availability)
Definition of non-renewable energy (finite resource, depleted by use, takes millions of years to form)
At least 2 valid renewable examples (e.g. solar, wind, hydro, geothermal)
At least 2 valid non-renewable examples (e.g. coal, oil/petroleum, natural gas, uranium)
